refresh_minutes.label: How often to check (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the widget asks for your latest usage.

window.label: Which limit to show
window.description: Claude Code has a 5-hour limit and a weekly limit. Show one of them or both.

display_mode.label: When to show the details
display_mode.description: The details are the time until the limit refills, the tokens and the bar.
display_mode.hover: Only when I point at it

logo.label: Picture in front
logo.description: Shown before the numbers. The ring is a small circle that fills up as you use the limit.

logo_path.label: My picture
logo_path.description: An SVG or PNG file. Leave empty to use logo.svg from the plugin folder.

show_prefix.label: Show which limit it is
show_prefix.description: Puts a short name such as “5h” or “7d” before each percentage.

show_bar.label: Show a progress bar
show_bar.description: A small bar next to the percentage.

gauge_mode.label: The bar and ring show
gauge_mode.description: Choose whether they fill up with what you have left or with what you have used.

show_reset.label: Show time until the limit refills
show_reset.description: A countdown to the moment your limit is full again.

ready_text.label: Text when the limit is full
ready_text.description: Shown instead of the countdown when you have not used this limit yet. Leave empty for “ready”.

show_tokens.label: Show tokens used
show_tokens.description: Tokens are pieces of text Claude reads and writes. Counted on your own computer.

include_cache_read.label: Also count re-read text
include_cache_read.description: Claude re-reads the conversation before every answer. Counting that makes the number much bigger.

dim_extras.label: Make the time and tokens dimmer
dim_extras.description: Only the percentage keeps the warning colours.

color_by_usage.label: Change colour as usage grows
color_by_usage.description: Turns to the warning colour, then the critical colour, at the levels below.

color.label: Normal text colour
color.description: Pick a colour from your theme or any colour you like.

click_command.label: My command
click_command.description: A command to run, for example alacritty -e claude to open Claude Code in a terminal.

command.label: Command on click
command.description: A command to run when you click the icon, for example alacritty -e claude.

animation_ms.label: Animation speed (ms)
animation_ms.description: How long the details take to slide in when you point at the widget. 0 = no animation.

percent_decimals.label: Decimals in percentages
percent_decimals.description: 0 shows whole numbers. Usage currently comes in whole percents, so decimals usually show .0.

launch_command.label: Command that opens Claude Code
launch_command.description: The panel uses it to open Claude Code in a terminal. The model and session you pick are added at the end.

click_action.label: Left click does
click_action.description: What happens when you left-click the widget. A right click always refreshes.

panel_translucent.label: See-through panel
panel_translucent.description: Lets your wallpaper show through the panel. The text stays sharp.

show_cost.label: Show what it would cost
show_cost.description: An estimate of what this usage would cost if you paid per token. With a Claude subscription you do not pay this.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Costs are converted from US dollars with the European Central Bank's daily rates, or with your own rate.

exchange_rate.label: My exchange rate
exchange_rate.description: How much of your currency 1 US dollar is worth. 0 = use the daily rate automatically.

ring_track.label: Show the ring's background
ring_track.description: A faint full circle behind the filled part.

format.label: My own text
format.description: Write your own text instead of the usual items. Words in braces are filled in: {window} {pct} {left} {reset} {tokens} {cost} {model}. Example: {pct} · {reset}. Leave empty for the normal look.

show_model.label: Show the current model
show_model.description: The Claude model you used last, for example Opus 5.5.

font_size.label: Text size (px)
font_size.description: 0 = the same size as the rest of the bar.

gradient.label: Smooth colour change
gradient.description: The colour shifts little by little as usage grows instead of jumping at the levels.

weekly_own_color.label: Different colour for the weekly limit
weekly_own_color.description: Used when both limits are shown.

hide_below.label: Hide until usage reaches (%)
hide_below.description: Keeps the widget out of sight while usage is low. 0 = always visible.

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Get one notification when usage passes a level.
notify.warning: At the warning and critical levels

custom_prices.label: Use my own token prices
custom_prices.description: Replace Anthropic's price list with your own prices, for every model.

price_input.label: Price of text sent to Claude
price_input.description: In US dollars per million tokens. Saving text for re-reading costs 1.25× or 2× this.

price_output.label: Price of text Claude writes
price_output.description: In US dollars per million tokens.

price_cache_read.label: Price of re-read text
price_cache_read.description: In US dollars per million tokens.

panel_resume.label: Show “Resume a session” in the panel
panel_resume.description: Buttons that reopen one of your latest Claude Code conversations.

limit_countdown.label: When a limit runs out, show only the countdown
limit_countdown.description: At 100% the widget shows just the time until you can use Claude Code again.

count_cache_writes.label: Also count text saved for re-reading
count_cache_writes.description: Off: only new text sent to and written by Claude. On: also the conversation Claude Code saves so it can re-read it quickly — after a pause a long conversation is saved again, so the number jumps.

error.no_credentials: Not logged in to Claude Code
error.token_expired: Login expired - open Claude Code once to renew it
error.bad_response: Unexpected answer from the usage service
error.http_429: Too many checks - trying again in a few minutes

panel.no_models: No usage in this window yet.
